Iran Strikes Jordan Base, Causing Limited Damage to Aircraft

Iran launched drone and missile strikes against the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, a facility used by U.S. forces. U.S. officials reported that the strikes caused limited damage, with multiple military aircraft sustaining damage. The extent of the damage to the base and its aircraft is still being assessed. The strikes were carried out by Iran.
